blocks.text: Acid rain (tezabi barish) atmosphere (fiza) mein nitric acid aur sulphuric acid ka mixture hai jo industrial pollution (karkhanon ki gandagi) se banta hai. Aam barish ke paani ka pH 5.6 ya is se kuch zyada hota hai, kyunke us mein carbonic acid (hawa ki CO₂ ghulne se) hota hai. Agar barish ka pH 5.6 se kam ho to woh acid rain ban jaati hai.

Acid rain atmosphere mein sulphur oxides (SOₓ) aur nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) ki wajah se hoti hai. Yeh gases, jo aksar industrial pollution se aati hain, paani (aur oxygen) se react kar ke sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) aur nitric acid (HNO₃) banati hain.

Jab acid rain mitti par girti hai to aik chemical reaction hota hai jo mitti se zaroori nutrients, jaise calcium (Ca²⁺), magnesium (Mg²⁺) aur potassium (K⁺), ko dho kar nikaal deta hai (leaching). Yun yeh nutrients paudon ke liye unavailable (na milne wale) ho jaate hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Mitti ke particles (zarron) ki surface par K⁺, Ca²⁺ jaise positive ions chipke hote hain. Barish ke H⁺ ions in ki jagah le lete hain, aur K⁺ ya Ca²⁺ azad ho kar paani ke saath beh jaate hain. Kitab ka “H₂⁺—Soil” matlab hai mitti par chipke do H⁺ ions, yani (H⁺)₂—Soil; yeh H₂⁺ naam ka koi alag ion nahi. Isi tarah “H₃⁺—Soil” matlab teen H⁺ ions.

Saath hi acid rain aluminium (Al³⁺) jaisi toxic metals (zehreeli dhaaton) ki solubility (ghulne ki salahiyat) barha deti hai. Phir paude ki roots (jarein) inhein absorb kar leti hain aur khud kharab ho jaati hain. Is se paude ki nutrients lene ki salahiyat kam ho jaati hai, growth (barhotri) sust hoti hai aur crop yield (fasal ki paidawar) ghat jaati hai.

blocks.alt: Aik manzar jo dikhata hai ke SOx aur NOx ke emissions (hawa mein chhorne) se badal mein tezabi barish kaise banti hai aur jheel aur mitti par kya asar karti hai.

blocks.long_description: Aik manzar. Aasmaan: Sunlight sooraj se dotted lakeer O3 tak; kaale badal mein khana 'Cloud Chemistry: Pollutant Oxidation (SO2, NOx) -> Acid Formation (H2SO4, HNO3) -> Dissolution (Acidic Raindrops)'; barish par 'Acid Rain H+, NH4+, NO3-, SO4 2-' aur do bare qatre HNO3 aur H2SO4. Daen: dhuan chhorti factory 'SOx / NOx Emissions', ghar ke oopar 'Dry Deposition (SO2 / NOx)', sarak par truck aur car. Zameen: 'Natural Ammonia'; machhliyon wali jheel, 'Water Acidification (Harmful to Life)'. Baen, darakhton ke neeche mitti ka hissa: neeche jaate teer, 'Soil Acid Leaching'; H+ se teer Ca2+ aur K+ tak, jo beh jate hain, aur Al3+ tak, 'Aluminum Release (Toxic)'.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Factory aur gariyon se nikalne wali SO₂ aur NOₓ badal mein oxidize ho kar H₂SO₄ aur HNO₃ banti hain, jo barish ke qatron mein ghul kar acid rain banati hain. Kuch gases barish ke baghair seedhi zameen par bhi baith jaati hain (dry deposition). Mitti mein barish ke H⁺ ions Ca²⁺ aur K⁺ ki jagah le lete hain, jo paani ke saath beh jaate hain, aur zehreela Al³⁺ azad ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 32.3 mein mitti wale teer ulte hain: Ca²⁺ aur K⁺ se Al³⁺ ki taraf. Kitab ki apni leaching equations ke mutabiq H⁺ ions Ca²⁺ aur K⁺ ko hatate hain (jo beh jaate hain) aur Al³⁺ ko azad karte hain. Hamari drawing mein yahi sahi rukh hai.

Paudon par seedhi girne wali acid rain patton ko nuqsan pohancha sakti hai aur unhein dehydrate (un ka paani khushk) kar sakti hai, jis se paude bimariyon aur environmental effects (mahol ke asraat) ke saamne vulnerable (kamzor) ho jaate hain. Acid rain nitrogen fixation (hawa ki nitrogen ko paude ke kaam ki shakal mein badalna) aur nutrition intake (nutrients lena) kam kar ke soybean aur wheat (gandum) ki paidawar ghata sakti hai. Yeh soil microbial communities (mitti ke microorganisms) ko bhi nuqsan deti hai, aur natural nutrient cycles (nutrients ke qudrati chakkar) aur organic matter ke decomposition (galne sarne) ko bigaar deti hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Acidic (tezabi) jheelon mein machhliyan kyun marti hain? Acid rain mitti se Al³⁺ azad karti hai, jo machhli ke gills (galphare) band kar deta hai aur oxygen absorption (oxygen lena) kam kar deta hai; is tarah machhli ka dam ghut jata hai (suffocation).

blocks.prompt: Acid rain mitti ki fertility (zarkhezi) kyun kam karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ke H⁺ ions mitti ke particles par K⁺, Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ki jagah le lete hain to yeh nutrients beh jaate hain, aur yeh zehreela Al³⁺ azad karti hai jo roots ko nuqsan deta hai.

items: Acid rain: pH 5.6 se kam; SOₓ aur NOₓ se H₂SO₄ aur HNO₃ bante hain.
H⁺ ions mitti se K⁺, Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺ nikaal dete hain (leaching) aur zehreela Al³⁺ azad karte hain.
Patte, soybean aur gandum ki paidawar, mitti ke microorganisms aur machhliyan mutasir hoti hain.
